tldr: The Sun through the 6th house brings attention to work, health, stress, routines, and daily maintenance.
body:
When the Sun moves through your 6th house, it brings attention to work, health, stress, routines, chores, habits, exhaustion, and what has become hard to maintain. You may notice the condition of your days more clearly: what is sustainable, what is draining you, and what your body keeps trying to report.

Something may feel more visible, energizing, exposed, or ready to be claimed. It can help you notice what needs more life, honesty, or direct attention.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for adjusting a routine before it becomes a bigger problem.

The caution: Watch for needing validation so badly that you miss what actually feels true. The risk is treating stress as normal just because you have learned how to keep functioning through it.

The Sun moves through this house for about a month. Use the visibility well. Put attention where it gives you more life, not just more approval.
